main_body: wooden gong frame with hanging metal gong
top_band: light tan-brown top surface of the horizontal crossbeam at rows 3-4 (plus front edge step at row 5); base blocks also show 3-row top bands at rows 26-28
evidence: Reading down the middle column: rows 3-4 are the light tan-brown top surface of the horizontal beam, row 5 is the front-edge step, rows 6-7 are the darker shaded front face of the beam overhanging the recessed gong and support posts below (rows 8-31). The base blocks also show clear 3-row top surfaces (rows 26-28) above their dark front faces (rows 29-31).

style.evidence: The wood frame uses a 5-step warm brown ramp and the brass gong uses a 6-step golden ramp with concentric specular highlights and hammered surface variation. Outlines are dark material tones (deep brown and dark bronze) with no black sticker lines.
